Title: ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX 3060 Ti Series Arrives | ZOTAC
URL: https://www.zotac.com/news/zotac-gaming-geforce-rtx-3060-ti-series-arrives
Published: 2020-12-01T02:53:25.000Z
Author: N/A
Highlights:
HONG KONG – December 1, 2020 – ZOTAC Technology Limited, a global manufacturer of innovation, today announced the ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX™ 3060 Ti Series, the latest addition to the RTX 30 Series powered by the advanced NVIDIA® Ampere architecture.

Powered by the NVIDIA Ampere architecture and the 2nd generation of NVIDIA RTX, the world’s most powerful PC gaming platform for real-time ray tracing and AI, the GeForce RTX 3060 Ti delivers blistering 1080p and 1440p gameplay starting at only $399 USD.

The RTX 3060 Ti also supports the trifecta of GeForce gaming innovations too, including performance-accelerating and IQ-enhancing NVIDIA DLSS technology which is now available in over 25 games; NVIDIA Reflex which reduces system latency (‘input lag’), making games more responsive, and giving players in competitive multiplayer titles an extra edge over the opposition; and NVIDIA Broadcast, a suite of audio and video AI enhancements including virtual backgrounds and noise removal that users can apply to chats, Skype calls and video meetings. So whether they’re playing traditional PC titles, powering through creator and productivity workflows, or marveling at the latest cutting-edge ray-traced titles like Cyberpunk 2077, Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War, Watch Dogs: Legion, and more, the GeForce RTX 3060 Ti delivers the best possible experience in its class for everyone everywhere.

GET AMPLIFIED

The ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX 3060 Ti Series introduces the Twin Edge OC and Twin Edge models. Both graphics cards feature a compact length of just 8.74 inch or 222mm in a dual slot configuration.

COOLING REFINED

The cooling solution is comprised of a wide aluminum fin-stack array heatsink paired with four 6mm copper heat pipes radiating from a single GPU cold plate. Dual 90mm 11 blade fans that provide up to 10% more airflow then previous generation designs, cool the cards while optimized for quiet performance. To allow more control, the Active Fan Control feature allows the user to independently control the speed of each fan. The Twin Edge OC model is further equipped with the FREEZE fan stop feature that automatically stops the fans when the GPU is idle for more efficient and quieter cooling.

GAME STRONG

A metal wraparound backplate ensures all-around protection, resulting in more durability and longevity of the graphics card. To get the best experience, tap into the latest version of ZOTAC GAMING FireStorm Utility to fine-tune your graphics card, monitor your GPU, adjust the fan speed with Active Fan Control, and more.
